    sequence = [factor * i % total for i in range(total)]

    if factor == 0:
        print(pow(total, total - 1, MOD))
        return

    visited = [False] * total
    cycle_counts = [0] * total
    result = 1

    for start_node in range(total):

            continue
        length = 0
        current_node = start_node

            visited[current_node] = True
            current_node = sequence[current_node]
            length += 1

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    for (int _ = 0; _ < T; ++_) {
        int total, factor;
        cin >> total >> factor;

        vector<int> sequence(total);
        for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
            sequence[i] = (factor * i) % total;
        }

        if (factor == 0) {
            long long answer = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
                answer = (answer * i) % MOD;
            }
            answer = pow(total, total - 1, MOD);
            cout << answer << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<bool> visited(total, false);
        vector<int> cycle_counts(total + 1, 0);
        long long result = 1;

        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total; ++start_node) {
            if (visited[start_node]) continue;
            int length = 0;
            int current_node = start_node;
            while (!visited[current_node]) {
                visited[current_node] = true;
                current_node = sequence[current_node];
                ++length;
            }
            cycle_counts[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total; ++size) {
            if (cycle_counts[size] != 0) {
                long long total_value = size * cycle_counts[size];
                if (size > 1) total_value += cycle_counts[1];
                long long power_result = 1;
                long long base = total_value % MOD;
                long long exp = cycle_counts[size];
                long long base_pow = base;
                long long e = exp;
                while (e > 0) {
                    if (e & 1) power_result = (power_result * base_pow) % MOD;
                    base_pow = (base_pow * base_pow) % MOD;
                    e >>= 1;
                }
                result = (result * power_result) % MOD;
            }
        }

        cout << result << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
